applicant.name: Dr. Test Applicant
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Vienna, Department of Epidemiology

purpose: Research on glycaemic control to improve diabetes care.
question: Among adults with type 2 diabetes, how many have poorly controlled diabetes, by hospital?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per hospital: adults with type 2 diabetes, how many of them have poor control and that share in %, one decimal.
